title: Import
lead: Add past data and its terms and relations go into the knowledge graph.

attach.title: Add files
attach.body: Tables (CSV, Excel), papers (PDF, Word), folders. Choosing one starts reading in a new chat.

graphium.title: Connect to Graphium
graphium.body: Copy Graphium's findings and topics, and build terms and relations.

fail.form: Could not connect. Enter the start file and the vault folder, or connect in Settings > MCP servers.
fail.node: node was not found. Connect in Settings > MCP servers and enter its location.
fail.tool: The connected server has no {{tool}} tool. Check the start file and the vault.
fail.old: This Graphium has no tool for exporting knowledge ({{tool}}). Please update Graphium.

graphium.scriptHint: The Graphium app was not found. Install Graphium, or enter where graphium-mcp.mjs is.
graphium.rootHint: The folder where Graphium keeps your notes

progress.note: Only the relation-picking step uses AI.
progress.cancelled: Cancelled. What was already done is kept.

result.added: Added {{terms}} terms and {{relations}} relations to the knowledge graph (unconfirmed).
result.candidates: {{n}} pairs without a stated relation (kept as candidates).

skip.ai_unset: AI is not set up, so no relations were picked. Set it up, then copy again to add them.
skip.off: Relations were not picked (turned off by the request).
skip.error: The relation-picking step failed. The copy is done. Copy again to pick them once more.
skip.cancelled: The relation-picking step was cancelled. What was already done is kept.
skip.aborted: The relation-picking step stopped after repeated failures. Check the AI setup and copy again.

result.label: Import result

sources.title: Imported
sources.confirmRemove: This deletes unconfirmed terms and relations. Confirmed ones and "wrong" records are kept. The copy is withdrawn and can be imported again.

reason.badResult: The result could not be read. Please import again.
reason.connectionLost: The connection for progress was lost. Check the result in the list.
reason.unknown: The import failed for an unknown reason.

notice.list: Could not load the imported list: {{reason}}
